notes.title: Valentine's Day/Lunar New Year Event is LIVE!
notes.content:
Lunar New Year/Valentine's Day event has begun (sorry, we're late!). It will end February 29th! Those who play the game during this event will receive the following:

-Heart Glasses - humans/squids
-Year of the Rat Ears - humans only
-Squid Heart Helmet
-Squid Love Tank
-Squid Winged Torso
-And all previous cosmetics for this event

[b][u]NEW STUFF[/u][/b]
-[b]IN-GAME CUSTOMIZATION! You can now customize your character while in-game, without having to return to the main menu![/b]
-New weapon info panels! When nearby a weapon locker, the info panel now shows weapon statistics instead of a description of the weapon
-Valentine's Day customizations and sprays
-Lunar New Year visuals
-Added a visual effect to the health bar when a unit's health is regenerating

[b][u]BALANCE CHANGES[/u][/b]
-AI Squid bowl move speed reduced to 75% of player-controlled Squid bowl move speed
-[b]Shield Overcharge has been redesigned. The area around the user now lasts 8 seconds, and grants each Squid soldier ally it touches a 75-health shield that lasts 8 seconds. Multiple Shield Overcharges from different users will stack[/b]
-Rifle and Chemical Launcher have received a new property, "Anti-Shields". Weapons with the Anti-Shields property deal 2x damage to shields

[b][u]BUGFIXES[/u][/b]
-Early Adopters DLC fixed
-Several performance optimizations that will hopefully allow the game to run better for most players
-Mutator shortcut hotkey on keyboard is now M instead of TAB\Mouse3
-Boost ramps will no longer attempt to launch vehicles going in the opposite direction of the boost
-Various fixes to map geometry and collision in Sunrise Heights
-When using gamepad, the targeting reticle of the player-driven Ice Cream Truck in Sunrise Heights will now follow the rotation of the vehicle (eg, if you turn, the reticle will rotate with the turn)
-When driving the player-driven Ice Cream Truck in Sunrise Heights, the truck-launched explosives will add the vehicle's velocity to their initial throw velocity
-Ice Cream Truck explosives should no longer appear stretched in practice mode
-Increased respawn invincibility time to 2.5s, from 1s. This mostly affects respawning with the Rise From Your Grave mutator active
-AIs should no longer attempt to return to base and heal if the Permadeath mutator is active, since the base healing volume is disabled while that mutator is active
-Fixed a bug that was causing servers to think there were players connected when there weren't, causing them to incorrectly stay active forever
-Medpack icons now properly disappear from the map when their associated medpack is on cooldown
-Various tweaks to fonts and visuals in some UI elements
-During the MVP lineup in the end-of-round flow, all elements of each MVP candidate's display now correctly set their visibility
-Practice Options Map\Mode Selector now properly checks whether it's being called from the main menu or not, and allows the "nuke" cinematic to play if called from the main menu
-Ammo and sprint bars now properly update when driving a vehicle
-Unoccupied vehicles can no longer pick up medpacks
-Players who own the Officer's Commission DLC should no longer see gift bag icons on certain customizations
-Added static resource map indicators in Sunrise Heights
-In practice mode, AIs on the opposite team should no longer sometimes get stuck in a loop when trying to pick up a weapon from a locker
-Friends List entries for friends running a different version of SQUIDS should now display properly

notes.title: Squids from Space Update Live!
notes.content:
[h1]SQUIDS FROM SPACE UPDATE[/h1]

It's been a while since our last update! But we've been working hard on squashing bugs, balancing, and updating the look of the game. We hope you'll check it out!


[h1][u][b]NEW/UPDATED[/b][/u][/h1]
- Updated look of Human eyes
- Updated human skin textures (removed make-up, dark knees, and can no longer see undies poking out from under the beach shorts)
- Tweaked blue/purple human clothing colors
- Tweaked human hair colors
- Updated the UI for the customization menu
- Updated UI for in-game scoreboard
- Mute List is now accessed from the in-game menu, rather than the scoreboard
- Removed muting from the scorboard UI, meaning you can now control your character again with the scoreboard up
- Added new audio for the end of round sequence
- New MVP categories: Environment-Based Kills, Important Takedowns, Dogs Rescued (only available for humans; capturing dogs as Squid is not rescuing them)
- Added more dogs to Heartland Acres
- Event feed now displays objective-related events (eg, flag pickup\drop\capture)
- New Squiddy mouse cursor in menus!
- Added a larger countdown UI element right before a round starts


[h1][u][b]Balance Changes[/b][/u][/h1]
- In Evergreen Trail, fallen tree logs to the center island have been replaced with geysers that springboard you to the center island
- In Mars Crash Site, moved some resources out of the north & south resource areas and towards each side's base
- Handcuffs cooldown reduced to 5s, from 10s
- Chemical Launcher heal reduction increased to 90%, from 67%
- Medigel Launcher projectiles now cause their target to apply 2x healing for 1.5s. Only Medigel Launcher projectiles apply this effect -- Medigel Burst aoe effect and Medigel puddles do not apply this effect
- Antimatterizer charge duration increased to 1.25s, from 1s
- Antimatterizer damage is significantly lower at low levels of charge (<0.5sec)
- Antimatterizer charge time to deal 100 damage increased from ~0.6sec to ~0.9sec
- Antimatterizer discharge time to deal 100 damage increased by ~25% (exact time depends on charge percentage)
- Phase Shift speed boost now only applies while the user is fully invisible
- Shield Booster duration reduced to 6s, from 8s
- Crawler Tanks summoned with Materialize Tank now take 5x damage after 2.5s of being unpiloted and will despawn after being unpiloted for 10s (unless they are being healed, eg with the Nanite Beam)
- Wormhole duration reduced to 45s, from 60s
- Exiting an Assault Mech is now instant
- Hot dog man resource value increased to 105, from 100 (other civilian types are unaffected)
- Added some crates in out-of-the-way places in Moonbase and Mars Crash Site so players have a chance of getting a rubber chicken

[h1][u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u][/h1]
- Bullets should more reliably deal damage when the attacker sees them visually hit an enemy, even in high-latency environments
- Players who crash or otherwise exit the game while carrying an object should no longer cause that carried object (eg, the flag) to get stuck in an invalid state
- Darkened and removed transparency from minimap background -- minimap icons should now be much easier to see, especially with peripheral vision
- Servers now load a random map on startup, rather than always loading Main Street CTF
- Flamethrowers and Antimatterizers now properly shatter frozen corpses
- Smoothed out many small UI issues
- Many AI behavior fixes
- Fixed clipping on many character customization
 (but not all, still working on it!)

In short, the rewards for proactively trying to return your flag as a team have been increased when the round is over 11 minutes old

notes.title: SQUIDS FROM SPACE - Another Update!
notes.content:
Greetings Earthlings! We've been overdue on an update! We had A LOT of things to fix! But we've also added a few new things to try out. Please grab the latest update and try it out! Let us know if you run into any issues.


[h1][b]NEW:[/b][/h1]
- Friends list
- Added a Refresh button to the collapsed server list
- AIs will now hop into a vacant passenger seat of vehicle you are driving if you order them to follow you!
- Main menu UI now shows the next set of unlocks you can earn
- Updated the credits! If you've helped us out with translation, your name should now be on there!
- Server browser will now display servers whose version ID is different than that of your client's, although you will not be able to join those servers. The UI will display whether the server is out of date, or if your client is out of date
- If you have Steam friends playing SQUIDS, they will now appear in the main menu and you can join their game!
- In-game voting: Vote Kick (vote to kick fellow players for any reason! kicked players will be banned for 30 seconds and kicking the same player subsequent times in the same map will ban them for 5 minutes each time)
- In-game voting: Change Map (vote to change the map after the current round is over)
- In-game voting: Enable/Disable All-Chat (by default, chat is team-only, but can be set to all-chat through this vote (does not persist through map rotation)

[h1][b]BALANCE CHANGES:[/b][/h1]
Balance changes to Airstrike:

- Squids killed by Airstrike no longer spawn Squid bowls


[h1][b]BUG FIXES:[/b][/h1]
- KotH UI now properly displays 4x4 & Assault Mech passengers as being inside the hill capture zone
- Fixed disembodied voices
- Lots of localization updates & fixes (still more to go)
- Fixed sizing of the invincibility volume in the Squid base of Heartland
- Crosshair reticle should now properly hide on all machines when using a gamepad
- Hitting ENTER while browsing in-game menus should no longer open in-game chat
- Charge weapons (eg, Optic Overloader) no longer automatically discharge if their wielder becomes disabled while they are charging. Note that this is different from the case where a player becomes disabled while their charge weapon is DISCHARGING over time (eg, Antimatterizer), in which case the discharge continues & is not interrupted
- Weapons should no longer spawn their projectiles inside static objects if their barrel in inside the object when fired
- Minimap now properly follows your spectator target when in spectator mode
- Assault Mech pilots & 4x4 drivers should now properly display text bubble emotes
- You can no longer get yourself into a bugged state by trying to switch teams very quickly
- You should no longer be able to fire the Assault Mech blunderbuss while punching by holding the fire button down
- TONS of graphical optimizations for cosmetics, weapons, & vehicles
- Sprinting while in midair no longer causes weird t-pose animations to occur. Gameplay effects are unchanged
- Fire hydrants will now put out an on-fire player in all situations
- Gas pump fuel streams are now flammable again
- Antimatterizer & Crawler Tank lasers now set flammable props on fire, as they always should have
- Added image for Heartland Acres in the practice mode map switch UI
- Spamming the fire button while wielding sequential-reload weapons (eg, Revolver or Shotgun) should no longer sometimes cause the reload animation to stop playing
- When switching teams from the team selector, you should now ALWAYS end up with the correct pawn on the correct team. We promise!
- The team selector UI is now much snappier, especially in high-latency environments
- The Wormhole technology can now *only* be activated if you are >=5m away from the entrance location
- [b]Rearranged trees in Evergreen Trail so that they are less-evenly distributed, creating clearer areas for combat and 4x4 driving and denser areas that players can decide to go into for cover[/b]
- Can no longer dash or toggle Gravitron Field while dead in a Harvester
- Using Force Respawn while piloting a vehicle now properly exits the vehicle before slaying your character, instead of destroying the vehicle
- Shooting an enemy character with Medi-gel no longer causes them to play their hurt VO
- Nanite Beam now destroys destructible props like crates (although not destructible *resources* like explosive barrels)
- Improved AI behavior around resource capture points
- Drastically improved the input mapping system
- Airstrikes now damage all destructible & flammable props
- Wheeled vehicles now destroy crates and other destructible props!
- Grenades now make splashes when they hit a water volume, and when they explode while inside a water volume
- Camera now pans when you possess a new pawn or swap spectator targets, instead of popping
- When an AI hears an order, they will now only respond "Roger!" when they actually change their behavior. This may cause instances where an AI refuses a player's order at first and then obeys it a few moments later once it completes its current task
- Moved the wrecked car out of the middle of the road in Heartland Acres
- Improved AI harvesting behavior: they now prefer to pick up higher value resources over lower value ones
- Improved AI navigation around crates in Evergreen Trail
- Improved AI healer behavior: added "flee" behavior if they do not have an offensive weapon and are being attacked while no allies are nearby
- 4x4/Rover throttle and reverse keys are now configurable
- Character customizations should now always save immediately upon exiting the customization screen
- Practice mode "Death Immunity" effect now properly applies when you are driving/piloting a vehicle
- Updated hair material visuals!
- Dual Revolver offhand weapon now properly applies your customizations
- [b]Dying right when picking up the flag with high latency should no longer cause the flag to get stuck in an uninteractible state[/b]
- Joining while another player is piloting an Assault Mech will no longer cause visual bugs on your client

notes.title: Squidmas Part 2! NEW GAME MODE!
notes.content:
[h1]GREETINGS EARTHLINGS![/h1]

SQUIDS FROM SPACE is currently on sale with a 75% discount! Grab it while you can!

This is part 2 of our Squidmas update! Here's what's new!

[b]New Game Mode: Capture and Hold is the name we're rollin' with.[/b]
[list]
[*]You still capture resources to level up weapons
[*]You must capture the enemy flag and keep them in 'jail'
[*]While you have the enemy flag jailed, you must also protect your own flag
[*]If you have BOTH flags in possession, the timer will begin to count down to 0
[*]The team with the timer that hits 0 first, wins.
[*]The timer will pause whenever a team loses possession of either flag
[/list]

[b]You can now tell AI what to do![/b]
[list]
[*]Pressing the "Follow Me" emote (UP directional on gamepad, or 1 on keyboard) near any AI that are NOT performing any tasks (meaning, they are just running somewhere) will cause them to follow you.
[*]Only 1 AI can follow you at a time
[*]You can dismiss the AI by telling them to 'Defend' (DOWN directional on gamepad, or 3 on keyboard). Telling them to 'Defend' doesn't mean they will stop where they are. All it does is cause them to stop following you and they'll continue on their merry way. This is probably just placeholder text as we do not yet have any localization for this new feature yet.
[/list]

[list]
[*]You will now get ejected from Assault Mechs when they are destroyed.
[/list]

[list]
[*]An alert icon "!" will now pop over your head when an invisible squid gets too close to you. This is what we're experimenting with as we realized invisibility can be pretty OP for squids that sneak up real close with an RPG or minisquid gun, etc.[/list]

[h1]Balance/Gameplay Changes[/h1]

[b]Minisquid Gun:[/b]
- Post-bounce range increased to 1000, from 800.
- Movespeed slow decreased to 0.025% per shot, from 0.075%.
- Movespeed slow duration decreased to 2s, from 3s.
- Damage over time increased to 10 over 2s, from 9 over 3s.

[b]Minisquid Blaster (Upgraded version of Minisquid Gun):[/b]
- Post-bounce range increased to 1250, from 1000.
- Movespeed slow decreased to 0.025% per shot, from 0.075%.
- Movespeed slow duration decreased to 2s, from 3s.
- Damage over time increased to 10 over 2s, from 9 over 3s.

[b]Antimatterizer:[/b]
- Beam width increased to 130, from 100.
- Max charge time reduced to 1s, from 1.5s.
- Damage per hit increased to 6~13, from 5~12.
- Bonus damage against vehicles increased to 50%, from 0%.

[b]HMG:[/b]
- Damage reduced to 6, from 7.
- Tracking reduced to 25, from 50.
- Reload time increased to 4s, from 2.5s.
- On-hit slow increased to 30%, from 25%.

[b]Medi-Gel Launcher:[/b]
- Healing increased to 10, from 6.

[b]Flamethrower:[/b]
- Rate of fire reduced to 0.06s, from 0.05s.
- Clip size reduced to 60, from 80.
- Range reduced to 160, from 200.
- Now does less damage to targets more than 80 units away, with damage decreasing with range.
- Overheat recovery threshold reduced to 25% ammo regen, from 50%.

[b]RPG:[/b]
- "Laser sight" reticle now extends out to the max distance of its rockets.
- Now properly aims at targets above or below the user.
- Aim time increased to 1.75s, from 1.25s.
- Projectile speed reduced to 1200, from 1400.

[b]Auto-Turrets:[/b]
- Fixed numerous bugs; turrets should now be targetable again, and all weapons should now damage them properly.
- Health reduced to 100, from 150.

[b]Invisibility:[/b]
- Human players within 600 range units of an invisible Squid player will now see an "invisible squid nearby" icon above their character.
- Aiming weapons like the Rifle and RPG now breaks invisibility.

We hope you enjoy the new game mode! Game modes will currently rotate every four maps. We have plans to implement a voting system in the near future. Keep an eye out!

If you want to keep up with our progress, please join our discord channel: http://discord.gg/squidsfromspace

With love and death rays,
Fun Bits

- When first handcuffed, invisible Squids are revealed.

- Increased stock cooldown to 5s, from 4s.
￼

￼

- Increased health to 400, from 300.
- Decreased Smash recovery time by ~0.75s.

￼

notes.title: Invasion of New Content + Free Weekend Celebration!
notes.content:
[b]Attention:[/b] Humans, Squids, fans of the game and those who have yet to make up their minds - the [b]Squids from Space[/b] dev team has just launched ton of new content, which has more than doubled the size of the game!

Starting today and thru this weekend, anyone can enjoy the epic battles with a [b]FREE WEEKEND![/b] If you enjoy the game, tell a friend! If they like it, we're also offering a limited time [b]20% off discount[/b] for purchase.

Free Weekend Runs: [b]Thurs Oct 12th 10am (PDT) - Oct 16th 10am (PDT)[/b]

What's New?

[b]NEW MAPS:[/b]
[u]Evergreen Trail:[/u] Located just outside of town, where the Squids have launched an assault on small group of campers. In this brand new forest map, there are 4x4's, bridge jumps and a different take on resource allocations that can turn the tide of battle at any moment.

[u]Mars Crash Site:[/u] Shortly after a massive Squid saucer crashed, the humans continue their assault on the Squids. Using vent jets to jump around the map, this map allows for a fast-action mayhem, on the martian surface. Let us know your thoughts on the new layout, as we continue to create content for Squids from Space!

[b]NEW SQUID WEAPONS:[/b]
[u]Micro-shard Accelerator:[/u] A vital component of the Squids' aresenal, this mid-range barrel weapon fires an extremely large ammo clip filled with tons of tiny shards that shred enemies to bits. Not even the family pack of band-aids are going to save you from this thing..

[u]Mini-Squid Gun:[/u] A large tank filled with tiny angry squids that fires multiple "squid bowls" at an enemies face to take them down. Each face-hugging squid bowl that smashes onto a human's face will slowly suck the life out of them. While the entry-level Mini-squid gun can do some serious damage, the upgraded version at Tech 2 can kill, as it increases the ammo-tank from 8 to12 squid-bowls.

[b]NEW HUMAN WEAPONS:[/b]
[u]Chemical Launcher:[/u] This handy heavy cannon fires grenades filled with a liquid chemical agent. If the grenade hits an enemy or wall, it will explode and disperse and area-of-effect cloud, which will cause enemies to cough, choke, sputter and lose lots of hit points.

[b]NEW VEHICLES:[/b]
In repsonse to the Squid Crawler Tank, the Humans have had to come up with a heavy-armored tank. The A behemoth human mech tank allows players to make their way into battle to pulberize some squids with a heavy ground-pound. The mech is also armed with a shotgun to take out any remaining squid-bowls that may be jumping toward a comrades face. The mech can also launch a bevy of high-powered rockets, if another player jumps into the tank to help out!

We have also added 4x4s, and a brand new Spider Tank for the Squids! 

[b]NEW CUSTOMIZATIONS:[/b]
Players can now pick and choose from a massive array of gear, hats, squid suits, colors and more. Kit out your avatar with more and more unlocks, as your experience continues to grow to unlock even more items.

[b]BALANCE, BALANCE, BALANCE:[/b]
Nothing is more important in a multiplayer game than team balance. We continue to adjust and tweak Squid and Human balance daily, thanks to constant playtests with our community. Keep up the feedback and the discord comments - we are listening and updating all the time, and we are always looking for those moments of "OP!!" and items that feel under-powered as we continue to push new content.

We will have some new updates and surprises this week as well for those who participate and pick up the game before the end of the month!

Thanks for playing, we'll see you on the battlefield!

Enjoy!

- Squids from Space Dev Team

notes.title: GET FABULOUS! Customizations are here!
notes.content:
[h1][b]GREETINGS, EARTHLINGS![/b][/h1]

[b]Phase One update has been released![/b]

Players can finally get their hands on the new Moonbase level and play around with our shiny new character customization system: "GET FABULOUS!"

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29017934/4e38951b7b39d14a7edcafc7d341c9eb6ccdf9ec.png[/img]

If you're a new player and just starting out in Squids from Space, you'll start out as either Squid or Humans with a base set of gear, skins, and color swatches. As you play, you will gain experience points for every round you complete. The more experience you collect, the more you will level up and unlock even more ways to create original personalized and unique Human avatars, Squid tanks, Squid Soldiers, Squid Bowls, and more! 

Here's a list of some of the major releases TODAY, with unlockable milestones you'll hit as you battle online:

At level 1 you can Get Fabulous, with a base set editable character features for both Human and Squids!

When you reach level 10 you'll see items like:
- New hats and sunglasses!
- Master Sergeant rank title!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29017934/3a1eeb59add618262e33c3598a34cfb6be897d98.png[/img]

Reaching Level 20 makes you an [b]Early Access Contributor![/b] You'll see items like:
- Sweet skins for your weapons, like Cobalt Blue or Hot Pink!
- Early Access Contributor title!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29017934/faf68fb7836c8ca7d7ac1f14feba812cdef64339.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29017934/a587fbe587930346506c2197931b753cb0ac8412.png[/img]

When you reach level 35 you'll see items like:
- Astronaut gear set for humans! 
- Lieutenant rank title!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29017934/30125c86e0e408973578fd9d25a10c2a71ca1785.png[/img]

The mighty players who reach Level 75 will get access to:
- The kickass Warmaster Crawler Tank gear set! 
- Commander rank title!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29017934/854622b2a6b1371c82f8a1db73a2e94c5f91d752.png[/img]

And if you are among the few who reach Level 101, you will become an [b]Early Access Veteran![/b] You'll see rare items like:
- Rare skins for your weapons like Golden, Diamond, and the Squid-tech
- Transparent set!
- Early Access Veteran title!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29017934/c5e440177f89f80d9974be8d4b7210b20e6fcfd5.png[/img]

This is just a small sampling of the exciting in-game gear and customizations that are coming to Squids from Space.  As you continue to battle online and level up, you will continue to unlock even more weapon sets, unique gear items, content, and colors. We will even be releasing some limited edition gear, titles and customizations JUST for our Early Access players. As the game continues to grow, we are excited to see our community explore, design, and build custom team sets for #TeamHuman military soldiers and #TeamSquid alien invaders.  

If you see a weapon during a game that someone else has unlocked and you'd like to try it, you can always exterminate them and steal their weapon. You will be able to enjoy using and playing with any "locked" weapon on the battlefield for as long as you can survive during that round.

We are delivering a large amount of content with this update and we can't wait to see what kind of crazy and unique looks our community creates with in the upcoming weeks. We're also interested to hear from YOU, in terms of what new items, gear sets, colors, and objects you'd like to see in our next update. If there's something you really want to see in the game, visit our [url=http://discord.gg/ZkhScjJ]Discord chat[/url] and let us know! The more people who holler at us for content, the more likely we'll be able to make it so.

Thanks for checking out the game. We're just getting started, and we're excited to continue delivering fresh content to our fans, and to continue dropping new weapons, gear, and surprises in the coming weeks.

With love and death rays,

The SQUIDS FROM SPACE Development Team


[h1]Known Issues:[/h1]
- Get Fabulous is best used with mouse/keyboard. Controller is functional, but needs some tweaking, improvement and bug fixes.
- We have a cheeky crash that we're currently hunting down, however let us know if you see a lot more crashes than last update.
- We have a lot of optimizations ahead of us, so any lag over 150+ ping and you may experience jittery gameplay
- Map rotation has been disabled at this time. We have a desync bug that has returned. We are investigating it now and will provide a hotfix ASAP.

notes.title: Localization and Balance Tweaks Update - Build v0.1.3
notes.content:
[h1]SQUIDS FROM SPACE LOCALIZATION UPDATE![/h1]

Here are the changes and known issues for Build v0.1.3:


[b]Gameplay & Balance:[/b]
[list]
[*] Frag Grenade stocks changed from 2 to 1.
[*] Frag Grenade stock recharge time changed from 4s to 6s.
[*] Tommy Gun spread angle changed from 15 deg to 25 deg.
[*] Tommy Gun bullet speed changed from 1500 to 1450.
[*] Tommy Gun bullet range changed from 550 to 500.
[*] Increased cooldown of human secondary weapon Airstrike to 30s, from 7s.
[*] Added a 5th power slot for Squids, which contains Mass Abduction. This 5th power slot unlocks at level 4, instead of Mass Abduction replacing Invisibility.
[*] Getting hit by the edge of an Airstrike or Mass Abduction will do 75 damage to humanoids and 375 damage to vehicles, instead of instantly killing the victim.
[*] After the first civilian spawn at the ~6:30 mark, civilians spawn every ~2:30 instead of every 4:00. Variance in these spawns is still ~30s.
[*] Both teams can now reach level 4.
[*] Civilians continue to spawn after one team reaches level 4.
[*] The enemy flag no longer returns to base once a team reaches level 4, unless the flag is captured or goes out of bounds.
[*] Teams still gain access to Airstrike/Mass Abduction at level 4, but those abilities have had their cooldowns greatly increased.
[/list]

[b]Settings:[/b]
[list]
[*] Several languages are now supported! This includes:
[list]
[*]French
-      France
[*]Italian
[*]German
[*]Spanish:
-      Mexico
-      Latin America
-      Spain
[*]Japanese
[*]Korean
[*]Polish
[*]Portuguese
[*]Brazilian Portuguese
[*]Russian
[*]Chinese
-      Simplified
[/list]
[/list]


[b]New Known Issues & Bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Players may see the civilian or flag icon appear at a different location from where they actually are until picked up.
[*] Tanks may not properly spawn on ramps or densely cluttered areas
[*] Some localized text may be cut off slightly on their UI elements.
[*] Tank Buster explosion decals do not appear in the right location when thrown onto the large grassy areas near the human base
[*] Players are able to repeatedly switch teams without a cooldown.
[*] AI Squid Bowls will get stuck in an invalid state (they will have INVALID PLAYER STATE above them.
[*] Squid tanks will still deduct energy even if they were unable to spawn in a certain location
[*] Those with integrated graphics cards or low end cards may encounter a crash. Currently investigating the issue.
[/list]

notes.title: ROADMAP - PHASE ONE: Early Access Launch Day
notes.content:
PHASE ONE: The Invasion Begins June 16, 2017 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29017934/08bfb024433eeb9ade51958be3d09eaf47ab85c3.jpg[/img]

SQUIDS FROM SPACE is officially LIVE!! Everyone can join us in playing version 0.1, the first Early Access release build! A huge thanks to our community and to everyone else who has helped us get this far!

At the time of this writing, it’s day one of Early Access. Here’s what’s in the game right now:

Main Street is our launch map. It uses Capture the Flag rules, and features humans and Squids in teams of 8 players each as they battle in the commercial district streets of a small town. Tons of objects around the map can be picked up and collected by each side, from oil barrels to jewelry. Large parts of the map are destructible as well, including the entire gas station!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29017934/fecd74229e3553c539f1782efb5254c54c28a134.jpg[/img]

Over 25 Weapons and Powers: Humans and Squids both have access to a ton of different weapons, with both sides having their own unique arsenals. In addition to primary weapons like the HMG or the Antimatterizer, humans have secondary weapons like grenades and auto-turrets, while Squids can activate special Powers like Shield Overcharge or Wormhole.

Vehicles: The Harvester and the Crawler Tank are the two vehicles in the game right now, both of them on the Squid side. The Harvester can quickly gather up metals, fuel, and other materials that the Squids desire, while the Crawler Tank is an armored war machine that can batter down even a sturdy human defense. As fans are enjoying the Squid vehicles, we are now investigating some potential Human vehicles to test in the near future.

Pretty Dang Fun To Play: We’ve had an incredible amount of fun developing and playing SQUIDS FROM SPACE, and we’re thrilled so far at the positive feedback we’ve received from our pre-release players. We’re just getting started and looking forward to growing our community and hoping to get everyone’s feedback on how we can make the game even better! 

The above feature list represents about 20% of the content we’d like to have in for our full launch next year. We want to add more maps, more weapons, a deeper progression system, as well as figure out the best ways to stay plugged into our community, so we can make sure that we’re taking SQUIDS FROM SPACE in the direction that everyone wants to see it go!

Our Goals and Roadmap

But that’s just where we are. The more interesting question is: what’s next?

Let’s get the biggest question out of the way first:

When will SQUIDS FROM SPACE be done with Early Access?

We’re probably going to be in Early Access for about a year, maybe more, maybe less. What are you going to add to SQUIDS FROM SPACE during Early Access?

We’re planning on adding more maps, more weapons, more vehicles, a special event system, character customization, a special streamer mode, clans, tournaments… lots and lots of stuff!

Okay, but, when are those things going to be added?

We have a lot of ideas for what we want to add, but as a small team, we need to make sure we’re working on the right things. We don’t want to add something only to find out afterwards that our community didn’t even want it in the first place! Basically, we want to gather data first on what our community wants us to add before we promise anything for post-Phase One.

So, while we don’t have any concrete answer for what is going to be released post-Phase One, we can talk about our overarching goals for Early Access. These goals are a bit more abstract; they aren’t so much specific features, but more like guideposts that we are using to help us determine what specific features we want to focus on.

Gather data on what our community wants. We only want to develop features that we think our community will actually engage with. As a small team, if we make something that our players don’t want, that is an enormous amount of wasted time.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29017934/c2c964e34fcd3459a24ecad21b25e79a6f75190e.png[/img]

Add depth to progression. The more you play, the more stuff you can unlock for your character! This also covers things like customization options received for participating in certain Special Events, or unique titles for completing certain achievements.

Give our community tools to grow. Multiplayer games live and die on the strength of their community of players. We want to help our players connect with each other, share strategies, form rivalries, and collaborate to create all sorts of memorable moments. Things like clans and special streamer modes fall under this goal. We may also look into supporting the mod community, but that will happen after we free up some team members to support that initiative after we are a little more than 50% thru Early Access development.

This concludes our Phase One roadmap discussion!  We hope we’ve given you an idea of where we are, where we hope to be soon, and the overarching goals we’re using to figure out where we want to be by the end of Early Access. If you have any questions, feel free to ask them here, or you can connect with us on social media or on Discord!

With love and death rays,

  -The Fun Bits Dev Team

notes.title: Launch Date Change!
notes.content:

notes.title: SQUIDS FROM SPACE v0.1 - Changelist
notes.content:
Here are the changes and known issues for Build v0.1:


[b]Gameplay & Balance:[/b]
[list]
[*] Players can now fall into manholes
[*] Removed ready-up system due to confusion
[*] Rubber Chicken hidden somewhere
[*] Swapped the Harvester controls so that the Gravitron was now the main control
[*] Destroyed fire hydrants and gas pumps now launch players into the air
[*] Balance changes for each Tech Level (Squid weapons and Human weapons) across the board, feedback welcomed!
[/list]

[b]Characters, Environment, FX:[/b]
[list]
[*] New Human base layout
[*] New Squid base layout
[*] 2nd pass on character animations
[*] Updated refugee models
[*] Updated Squid model
[*] Squidlings now ragdoll when their bowl is destroyed
[*] Added basketball court
[*] Updated some of the weapon models
[*] Lots more explosions, fire, and weapon fx across the board
[*] Added winning team victory effects
[*] Added a night time map
[*] Added the ability set the environment on fire with a flamethrower
[/list]

[b]UI:[/b]
[list]
[*] Icons for tanks and harvesters have been added to the Map/Minimap
[*] Map key has been moved to Tab or middle mouse wheel click for keyboard
[*] New scoreboard UI layout
[*] Added icons for what weapons your team has equipped
[*] Added an end-of-round stat screen
[*] Added a victory screen
[/list]

[b]Streamer Support:[/b]
[list]
[*] Volume slider now saves it's position correctly
[*] More Stream-worthy moments added to in-game combat and finale
[/list]


[b]Known Issues & Bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Team balancing is working incorrectly. It may not always switch players over to a new team from the last round.
[*] When hopping into a squid suit or squidding a human, you may briefly see a camera glitch, and/or the world origin of the map
[*] The icons for refugees appearing on the minimap are missing (Fixed in next build)
[*] Scrolling beyond the bottom of a menu with the gamepad may cause it to stop working. Need to use the mouse to refocus the menu. (Seems to be fixed in next build, as I CNR)
[*] Strange crash that MAY occur at the end of the round after the Victory Screen and before the end of the round. May be hardware related.
[*] Spamming more grenades than available is sometimes possible.
[*] Notifications for a flag returning to the base may not always play a sound
[*] Username font is difficult to read, will be updated in next rev
[*] Team weapon icons are difficult to see on the stat page
[*] Text is not scaling properly on the loading screen when the resolution is changed
[*] Weapons/Powers still need balancing tweaks
[*] Crash occurs when attempting to maximize the window while the game loads
[/list]
